crossRefs.note: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

parallels.note: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”
Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

translations.web: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”
translations.bsb: In the resurrection, then, whose wife will she be of the seven? For all of them were married to her.”
translations.kjv: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
translations.asv: In the resurrection therefore whose wife shall she be of the seven? for they all had her.
